findings.quote: they sent an embassy asking the Rhodians to take them and their city into their protection
findings.problem: The Greek reads 'πρεσβεύειν μὲν ***, ἐγχειρίζοντες σφᾶς αὐτοὺς καὶ τὴν πόλιν': there is a lacuna after πρεσβεύειν, and the Rhodians are not named in the text. The English fills the gap with an invented object and recipient.
findings.proposed_fix: they sent an embassy [text lost in the Greek], entrusting themselves and their city

units.note: Lacuna marked *** in the Greek. The Rhodians are the likely recipients from the context (next sentence), but the Greek does not say so.

findings.quote: But the supporters of Canuleius and Quintus testified against Menyllus and the envoys who had come from the elder brother
findings.problem: 'τῶν δὲ περὶ τὸν Κανολήιον καὶ Κόιντον ἀπομαρτυρούντων τοῖς περὶ τὸν Μένυλλον ... διότι καὶ τὴν Κυρήνην ὁ νεώτερος καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα δι᾽ αὐτοὺς ἔχοι': Canuleius and Quintus (and their party, i.e. the commissioners themselves, not 'supporters') bore witness in support of Menyllus and the elder brother's envoys, confirming that the younger brother held Cyrene and his life through them. 'Against' inverts the sense, and the clause that follows makes sense only as corroboration.
findings.proposed_fix: But Canuleius and Quintus and their colleagues bore witness in support of Menyllus and the envoys who had come from the elder brother

findings.quote: seeing on the one hand that the division had been completely settled
findings.problem: The Greek reads 'ὁρῶσα τὸν μερισμὸν *** γεγονότα τελέως': there is a lacuna between μερισμὸν and γεγονότα, and the English reads on as if the text were whole.
findings.proposed_fix: seeing on the one hand that the division had been [text lost in the Greek] completely made

units.note: Lacuna marked *** in the Greek. In the first finding, 'them' (δι᾽ αὐτούς) is itself ambiguous in the Greek; I leave that untouched. Confidence is medium because ἀπομαρτυρέω with the dative is uncommon, but 'testify against' is not the natural sense and the context favours support.
